def config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str:
    """Return the value bound to key in name=value config text, or "" when key is absent.

    Each line is read as name=value. Surrounding whitespace on names and values is
    trimmed, blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped, and lines without =
    are ignored. When a key appears more than once, the first occurrence wins.
    """
    pre key != ""
    post out.byte_len() <= text.byte_len()
    ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
    ex config_value("a = 1\n# c\nb=two", "a") == "1"
    ex config_value("a=1\na=2", "a") == "1"
    ex config_value("a=1", "z") == ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if line == "" or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        name, sep, val = line.partition("=")
        if sep == "":
            continue
        if name.strip() == key:
            return val.strip()
    return ""
